name: Cozy Catch
detailed_description:
🎣 Cozy Catch

Cast your line. Reel in the weird.

Beneath the still surface of quiet lakes lies something strange. In this spooky-cozy idle fishing game, you’ll upgrade your gear, catch bizarre aquatic creatures, and customize your eerie little angler as you explore a world full of mystery and charm.

Whether you’re actively clicking or just letting time flow, every catch uncovers a little more of the odd world beneath the waves. Fish, collect, chill—and embrace the weird.

🔹 Features:

  • 🎣 Simple but addictive gameplay — React fast to catch fish, or simply exist and let em pass.

  • 🔍 Unique trinkets & hooks — Modify your fishing style with passive upgrades that alter how you play.

  • 🌙 Day/Night Cycle — Watch time pass and the environment shift.

  • 🧢 Cosmetic Customization — Unlock hats and trinkets to make your angler uniquely yours.

  • 🌲 Pixel Art Atmosphere — A rich, hand-crafted world full of strange charm and more and more and even MORE PIXELS.

  • 🐟 Fish Collection — Catch and catalog an odd cast of aquatic lifeforms.

  • 🎲 Pearl Gacha (Just for Fun) — Trade in pearls found during your angling adventures to roll for rare characters, companions, bobbers, fishing rods. No real money, ever — just fishy luck and weird cosmetics.

short_description: An idle fishing game with pixel art charm and a spooky-cozy twist. Cast your line, reel in strange and rare fish, upgrade your gear, and explore eerie biomes beyond the peaceful forest where you begin. Simple mechanics, relaxing vibes, and plenty of hidden treasures await.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compliant video card
  • Storage: 80 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gamepads not compatable
